curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain signal layout, single-light rural intersections, dark signals, officers at signals, and the steady and flashing red lights and arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each red signal; contrast cards for steady versus flashing red and red arrows, and a dark signal as a stop sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a red signal and asking what you must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach right on red, the one-way to one-way left on red, and the stop-yield-stay-in-lane sequence.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each turn-on-red rule; a contrast card for right versus left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a turn on red and asking whether it is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover steady and flashing yellow lights and arrows, then steady green, waiting for cross traffic, left turns on green and green arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each yellow and green signal; contrast cards for steady versus flashing yellow and green ball versus green arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a yellow or green signal and asking the action.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what pavement lines do, edge lines, white lane lines dashed and solid, and where to stop at a crosswalk.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each white-line and crosswalk rule; contrast cards for white versus yellow and dashed versus solid white.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a white line and asking whether you may cross it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach solid and double yellow lines and their two exceptions, dashed yellow, mixed dashed-and-solid lines and passing zone signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each yellow-line rule; contrast cards for dashed versus double solid, the line nearest you and the farm equipment exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a yellow line and asking whether you may pass.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the shared center lane for left turns and U-turns, then reversible lanes and their overhead lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each special lane; a contrast card for shared center versus reversible lane markings.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on special lane markings and lights.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover reserved bus, bike and car pool lanes and the half-block turning rule, then flex lanes, the truck ban and the lane lights and merge sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for reserved and flex lane rules; contrast cards for the half-block rule, trucks in flex lanes and yellow X versus red X.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a lane light or reserved lane and asking what you may do.
